entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi, yes, I... I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I got it a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working for me.
I'm sorry to hear that it's not meeting your expectations. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide your full name and order number?
Sure, it's Anna Garcia. The order number is... VF88-12-9034.

Thank you, Anna. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 28th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's definitely not broken. It's just... so confusing. The whole system is really hard to use. I feel a bit overwhelmed by it all, honestly.
I understand that new tech can sometimes have a learning curve. Could you give me an example of something you've found confusing? That will help me understand what you're experiencing.

Well, everything. I can't figure out how to track my different activities. I thought I could just press a button for 'run' or 'bike'. I've looked at the user manual, but it just shows a bunch of menus. I guess I just expected more from the interface. Can't you just help me return it?

I hear your frustration, and I absolutely can help you. It sounds like you're looking for a simpler way to start your workouts, and that's actually one of the VeloBand's best features, it's just a little hidden. Do you have the band with you now? We can try customizing the home screen together in about 60 seconds.
Oh. Um, I guess. Yes, I have it right here.
Great. Please tap the screen to wake it up. Now, press and hold your finger on the main clock face for about three seconds. Do you see a little gear icon or a 'Customize' option appear?
Okay... holding... Yes! It says 'Customize'.

Perfect. Tap that. You should now see options for 'Widgets' or 'Shortcuts'. Tap on 'Shortcuts'. This is where you can add your favorite activities right to the main screen. You can add 'Run', 'Bike', 'Swim', whatever you use most. Go ahead and add 'Run' to one of the shortcut slots.
Wow. Okay... I tapped 'Shortcuts'... and 'Add'... I see 'Run'. I've added it. Now it's on the main screen when I swipe left.
Exactly. So now, instead of going through menus, you can just wake the screen, swipe once, and tap 'Run' to begin tracking instantly. You can add up to four of your most-used activities there.
Oh my gosh. That's... that's actually what I wanted it to do from the beginning. Why wasn't that in the user manual? That changes everything.

I'm so glad that helped! That's excellent feedback about the manual, and I'll be sure to pass it along. We want the experience to be intuitive from the moment you open the box. Knowing this now, are you still considering a return, or would you like to give the band another try?
No, no, I think I'll keep it. This one feature makes it so much better. I was just so lost. Thank you for taking the time to explain that.
Of course, Anna. That's what we're here for. I'm happy we could find a solution that works for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. You've been a great help, Charlie. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
